rendered.tool: hardware/cad/tools/stl_props.py (signed tetrahedra, axis z through origin)

printed.note: I_z_scaled = rendered I_z * printed mass / rendered mass; geometry is fixed, only density differs

measured.method: acceleration run: K_t*i_q / (alpha_accel + |alpha_coast|) per 0.25 s window, six torque steps 0.05/0.10/0.15 Nm both directions (bench coast-down --accelerate)
measured.note: total rotating inertia: disc + screws + motor rotor and hub. Disc-only cannot be separated; the excess over the scaled render is 0.000024 kg m2 (6.8 %), the rotor share. K_t 0.0244 Nm/A from 2026-10-26-torque-constant.json

mounting.note: point masses on the rotor bolt circle; negligible

assembly.note: disc + screws, excluding the motor rotor; rotor inertia comes from the bare-rotor coast-down
